To measure resistance values set the function switch to the
desired ohmic value and read the green scale.
Remember to multiply the value indicated on the display by the
multiplier factor at the switch position.
To measure DC voltage values set the function switch to the
desired voltage and read the black scale on the display.
If you are using the 0.6 or 60 setting, read the numbers on the bottom portion of the black scale.
When the range switch is set to 0.6 you must divide the numbers on the scale by 10 (1 = 0.1, 2 = 0.2, 3 = 0.3, 4 = 0.4, 5 = 0.5 and
When the range switch is set to 60 you must multiply the numbers on the scale by 10 (1 = 10, 2 = 20, 3 = 30, 4 = 40, 5 = 50 and 6 = 60).
If you are using the 12 or 1000 setting, read the numbers on the middle portion of the black scale. .
If the range switch is set to 12, the numbers on the scale range from 0 to 12.
If the switch position is at 1000, you must multiply the
numbers on the scale by 100 (2 = 200, 4 = 400, 6 = 600, 8 = 800,
If you are using the 3 or 300 setting, read the numbers on the
top portion of the black scale.e..............
If the range switch is at 3, you must divide the number
If the switch position is at 300, you must multiply the number
When measuring AC voltages, read the red scale on the display.
The switch position will indicate which range the scale measures (0 - 12, 0 - 30, 0 - 120, 0 - 300, 0 - 1000).
When the range switch is on 12, 120, or 1000 read the middle scale. Multiply the numbers on the scale by 10 when the range switch is set to 120 and 100 when the range switch is set to 1000.

When the switch is set to 30 or 300 read the top scale. No multiplication or division is needed when the range switch is set to 30; however, when the range switch is set to 300 you must multiply the scale's numbers by 10.

Current can be measured by using the DC A or DC10A switch position. The mesured value is read using the DC scale. Ensure the lead is placed in the DC10A jack when you use the DC10A range setting. g DC10A jack and
To check battery life, use the BAT switch position.
